"rule=<id>:<name>:<1|0>" lines restore the enabled/disabled state of each rule. "pm_rule=" / "pm_rule_end" blocks restore the NFA partial match state of each pattern matcher, allowing in-progress stateful pattern sequences to survive a shutdown/restart cycle. Counter lines (events_received=, etc.) are intentionally skipped because they are cumulative since engine initialisation and cannot be meaningfully restored.
